fields.name: Shard set
fields.definition: A named collection of shards: databases with essentially identical schemas, each holding a distinct segment of one dataset. A shard set is addressed as a unit, both to route a record to the shard that holds it and to fan one query out across all (or a targeted subset of) its shards. It is configured by `ShardSetName` and retrieved by that exact key (casing, accents and kana must match). An application may define several shard sets, each an independent partitioning plan, but most define one.
